# Recommended GitHub Labels

The following labels are recommended for this repository.

| Label | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| bug | Software defects |
| documentation | Documentation improvements |
| enhancement | Improvements to existing functionality |
| feature | New functionality |
| question | User questions |
| help wanted | Community contributions welcome |
| good first issue | Good starting point for new contributors |
| duplicate | Duplicate issue |
| invalid | Invalid issue or request |
| wontfix | Issue will not be addressed |
| dependencies | Dependency updates |
| github-actions | GitHub Actions workflows |
| schemas | JSON Schema updates |
| api | API documentation and specifications |
| integrations | Integration guides |
| examples | Example code and sample files |
| architecture | Architecture documentation |
| security | Security-related issues |
| ai | Artificial Intelligence features |
| roadmap | Roadmap and planning |
| commercial | Commercial edition discussions |

---

## Notes

GitHub labels can be created manually under:

**Repository → Issues → Labels**

These labels are recommendations and may be customized to fit the project's workflow.
